notes: Two speakers in the same group (kepler): the sales rep says Dec 3 (m3), the logistics coordinator (authority delivery. only) books Wed 12/9 (m5) -> contested, delivery_deadline unknown (12/9 would miss Dec 7). m7 is the trap: the rep restates Dec 3 and says she will have Marcus fix it, but that only refreshes HER value; Marcus's 12/9 is still his latest statement, so the term stays contested at the m7 checkpoint (her restatement supersedes her own m3 statement with the same value). Only m8, where Marcus corrects himself to 12/3, removes the conflict: both speakers now say 2,000 on 12/3. Marcus never states a quantity; his schedule qty is the full 2,000 order he booked. Distractors: opp #, PRO numbers, 5 pallets / 1,140 lb, PO-7713 and PO-7302, $8.65 old price, proj 26-114, phone numbers.
